empty-warning-shows-even-when-days-exist.why: The "this calendar is empty, so every business-day deadline is computed as though Fridays were the only non-working days" warning shows even when the year HAS holidays, which turns a wrong-answer alert into noise people learn to ignore. sla-policies.spec.ts dies. REPOINTED: the original read `rows != null && rows.length === 0` and the screen later became per-YEAR, so the collection is now `view.holidays` — a real code change rather than formatting.

conflict-message-swallowed.why: The server's 409 naming the day already taken is swallowed and replaced by a generic sentence, so two people working from one published holiday list are told "something went wrong" instead of which day collided. sla-policies.spec.ts dies. REPOINTED: `setAddError` no longer exists — every write on this screen now goes through one `setActionError` with a per-call fallback key, which is why the anchor includes `fallbackKey`.
